name: KpiScorecardBoard
tagline: The KPI Scorecard Board turns a list of KPI records into a live scorecard.
description: The KPI Scorecard Board turns a list of KPI records into a live scorecard. Each KPI shows its actual value against its target, how much of the target has been reached (attainment), a clear status (on track, at risk, off track or no target) and whether it is improving compared with the previous period.
features: Summary strip with overall attainment ring and a status bar showing the share of KPIs in each status
Status filter chips with counts, a search box (KPI, group or owner) and a sort menu
Tiles or list layout, optionally grouped by perspective with collapsible sections and group attainment
Trend arrow and change % against the previous period that knows whether up is good or bad
Details panel with actual, target, gap to target, attainment, previous period and change, plus Open record
Clear messages for missing values and incorrect settings, and a dedicated phone layout
